text:
leah: heads-up from nightly onboard: sirocco-v2 int8 shows bracket/mirror mismatches in mixed Arabic+CJK samples. pretty consistent: opening bracket becomes closing in Arabic spans.
amir: whoa, can you paste a minimal repro?
leah: repro command:
```
python tools/run_multilang_eval.py --model sirocco-v2 --quant int8 --suite tests/fixtures/multiscript/bracket-mirror --log-output
```
leah: sample diff (src / ref / sirocco-v2):
SRC:    "（مرحبا) 世界"
REF:    "（مرحبا) 世界"
SIROCCO: "）مرحبا( 世界"
leah: note the fullwidth paren got mirrored and moved. happens when Arabic RTL span adjacent to fullwidth left paren.
yuta: is this generation-side or detokenization? token logs?
leah: token log shows tokens emitted in expected logical order but the detoker is applying Unicode BIDI mirroring incorrectly when combining fullwidth punctuation + Arabic RTL mark. interestingly float16 baseline is correct. int8 emit sequence: ["\uFF09","مرحبا","\uFF08"," ","世界"] whereas float16 emits ["\uFF08","مرحبا","\uFF09"," ","世界"].
amir: so int8 causes token id remap that swaps the paren ids (or merges with directionality markers). can you grep for U+FF08/FF09 in qvocab?
leah: grep shows FF08 and FF09 mapped to distinct ids in vocab, but int8 qvocab remap introduced alias id 51234 that collapses mirrored pairs for space savings. looks like aliasing broke correct pairing when adjacent to strong RTL characters.
eval-bot: automated alert: bracket_mirroring_regression detected on branch bringup/sirocco-v2-int8 for locale set [ar, ja, zh-Hans]. delta_bleu=-0.06 for punctuation-sensitive test.
yuta: any RTL-only cases? does it affect pure Arabic?
leah: pure Arabic ok mostly; problem surfaces only when fullwidth/halfwidth punctuation from CJK scripts directly abuts RTL run without delimiter. also affects some Hebrew testcases.
amir: mitigation idea: avoid applying qvocab aliasing for punctuation codepoints in cross-script contexts. quick patch: disable alias 51234 when next token has bidi property R or AL. daft but quick.
yuta: also add unit tests to tests/multiscript/edge_punct to catch this.
qa-bot: creating ticket ML-1423 and adding regression-block label to sirocco-v2 int8 rollout.
leah: I'm opening a PR to disable aliasing for punctuation codepoints; will include a small token-level check in the detok pipeline to preserve original codepoint order when bidi adjacency detected.
amir: nice. if we can't fix fast, hold int8 rollouts for customers using mixed CJK+RTL captions.
yuta: also run full eval set with zh-Hant and he locales added.
leah: will push new nightly with added tests; ETA ~6h. will report back.
